† I. [נָתַר] vb. spring or start up;—
Qal Impf. וְיִתַּר מִמְּקוֹמוֹ Jb 37:1 yea, it (the heart) starts up from its place (‖ יֶחֱרַד).
Pi. Inf. לְנַתֵּר בָּהֵן עַל־הָאָרֶץ Lv 11:21 (P), to leap with them (i.e. its legs) upon the earth (of locust).
Hiph. Impf. וַיַּתֵּר גּוֹיִם Hb 3:6 he (י׳) looked, and made nations start up.
